name: EthOS Download Manager
description: HTTP, magnet and debrid downloads with a priority queue, categories, a daily schedule, bandwidth limits and RSS rules — in a native EthOS window.
author: SyncHot
changelog: 1.0.0: first release — live queue with drag-and-drop ordering, pause/resume/reset/delete, add via URL, magnet or .torrent, categories, a daily start window, global/per-task speed limits, debrid provider setup, qBittorrent key management, RSS rules and watch folders.
